changelog:
1.5.7
  CHANGED: Multiplayer network ownership — client sends full clientState (body/dir/score/alive) before each tick; host uses body as-is, no local movement of remote snake
  CHANGED: State message streamlined — single snake key (host snake only), client keeps its own body
  CHANGED: sendSwipe() is now local-only enqueue, no per-swipe network message
  ADDED: Client camera init in applyState() and start handlers — game starts even if start message dropped
  ADDED: Colors redundantly synced via state() message every tick
  ADDED: bossTarget cleared on death
  FIXED: Dead snake body cleared at every death point — no phantom hitbox after visual disappearance
  FIXED: Remote snake jitter — host no longer moves remote snake independently
  FIXED: Client prediction no longer runs boss AI, boss spawn, or food refill (host authoritative)
  FIXED: Host removes food at remote snake's current head — food eaten by client properly disappears
  FIXED: Client game loop ticks independently of host state arrival — no more lag pauses
  FIXED: isHost set AFTER server/client reference (volatile happens-before ordering)
  FIXED: toggleReady() null-safe guard
  FIXED: Empty snake body guards in engine update and clientState handler

1.5.6
  ADDED: Dev mode force boss type (RANDOM/CHASER/WALL); show boss pathfinding toggle with target, arrow, danger radius
  ADDED: Lobby UI with player names, snake previews in actual colors, ready status
  ADDED: Boss player-body avoidance scoring (preferred, not hard block); adjacent penalty
  FIXED: TCP_NODELAY on sockets; volatile writer in GameServer/GameClient
  FIXED: bodyColor now synced via hello message (clientBodyColor used in resetGame)

1.5.5
  ADDED: PLAY_MENU and MODE_SELECT states; SINGLEPLAYER/MULTIPLAYER/BACK navigation; ARCADE mode
  CHANGED: PLAY button replaces START + LOCAL MULTIPLAYER

1.5.4
  ADDED: Boss evasion AI (danger radius 7, 40/60 evade/task, turn limits, hesitation); brute-force fallback
  CHANGED: Alignment bonus outweighs turn penalty; wall range 3->6, avoid border; food thresholds 50/175/375/550/825
  FIXED: Boss trail length; app switching preserves state

1.5.3
  ADDED: Wall Builder boss type (3 walls, preview, grow-in, crumble); 40/60 boss type selection
  CHANGED: Boss interval 125->100; trail fruit no longer grows snake
  FIXED: Multiplayer wall/preview/boss sync

1.5.2
  FIXED: Lobby labels; host game loop; auto-start

1.5.1
  ADDED: UDP multicast; YOU/PARTNER/SUM score; boss body kills on contact
  CHANGED: Boss spawn and food use combined score
  FIXED: Boss damage sound; boss avoids own body

1.5.0
  CHANGED: Boss is now a moving snake that eats food; head/body contact damages it; trail on teleport

1.4.4
  ADDED: Color picker with HSV; snake color in Settings; boss damage sound
  CHANGED: Update download auto-installs
